name: Lviv National Opera
description: Historic opera house and one of the most recognized landmarks of Lviv.

name: Latin Cathedral
description: A Roman Catholic cathedral with Gothic and Baroque architectural elements.

name: Potocki Palace
description: A 19th-century palace now used as an art museum and exhibition venue.

name: Boim Chapel
description: An ornate chapel famous for its rich decorative Renaissance facade.

name: Bernardine Monastery
description: A fortified monastery complex with significant cultural and architectural value.

name: Maria Zankovetska Theatre
description: Historic neoclassical drama theatre and one of the best-known stage buildings in Lviv.

name: St. George's Cathedral
description: A landmark baroque-rococo cathedral set on a hill above the city center.

name: Shevchenkivskyi Hai
description: Open-air museum of folk architecture with historic wooden buildings and churches.

name: Lviv High Castle
description: Historic hilltop castle site and one of the most recognizable panoramic landmarks in Lviv.

name: Monastery of St. Onuphrius
description: Historic monastery complex north of the Old Town at the base of Castle Hill.
